scope: Individually reviewed original assertions, native and Valgrind; provider children use matching commands from the private PATH. Pending and excluded originals are not executed.
launch_profile: Valgrind locates the named command through a private PATH, preserving its initial argv[0]. Subsequent child execs remain traced.

remaining.review_scope: Original explicitly reproduces a historical segmentation fault. Ordinary recursive include/exclude behavior is covered separately.
